description:
Find the Microburbs endpoint that answers a question, in plain words —
e.g. "median rent over time", "is this house in a flood zone", "schools
near 10 Smith St", "japanese ancestry". Typo-tolerant, knows synonyms,
matches response field names. Returns the best endpoints first, each with
its `name` (pass it to `call_endpoint`), REST path, price in cents and
parameters; a dataset's result also has `coverage` (measured or modelled,
geography, states, areas covered, time span). Optional `section` keeps only
one docs section, e.g. "Suburb - Crime" or just "crime"; `level` (suburb,
lga, postcode, sa2, block, property, points...), `state` (nsw, vic, ...)
and `period` (a year, e.g. "2019") keep only datasets that match. Free.
name: search_endpoints
title: Search endpoints
